questions.question: What is your approximate annual revenue for 2023, 2024, and 2025?
questions.context: We need these figures to complete the Horizon Farm Credit loan application. The lender requires 3 years of income history.

questions.question: Do you have a signed lease agreement with Don, or is it a verbal arrangement?
questions.context: Horizon Farm Credit requires proof of land access. A signed lease strengthens the application significantly.

questions.question: What loan amount are you looking for, and what will the funds be used for?
questions.context: Need to know the specific dollar amount and purpose (equipment, operating capital, infrastructure, etc.) for the application.
questions.answer: I am looking for $20,000 for debt consolidation off of HIGH interest credit cards, I am looking for $18,000 for an operating loan to get my season kicked off

questions.question: What is the EXACT legal name of your LLC? (Must match your state registration exactly)
questions.context: This must be identical to your LLC filing - D&B will verify against state records. Example: 'Tiny Seed Farm LLC' not 'Tiny Seed Farm'

questions.question: What is your business PHYSICAL address? (No P.O. boxes allowed)
questions.context: D&B requires a physical street address. This is where your business operates or where you receive business mail at a physical location.

questions.question: What is your business phone number?
questions.context: Must be a working number where D&B can reach you to verify. Can be a cell phone.

questions.question: What is your title/role in the company?
questions.context: Example: Owner, CEO, Managing Member, President

questions.question: How many employees does the business have (including yourself)?
When did your business start? (Year is fine)
questions.context: The year your LLC was formed or when you started operating

questions.question: Brief description of what TinyPM does (1-2 sentences)
questions.context: D&B needs a business description. Example: 'Software company developing AI-powered project management tools'
questions.answer: TinyPM is the first AI project manager built     as a team of specialized agents—an Overseer      that coordinates, a Scribe that remembers        everything across every session, an Artificer    that executes, and a Mentor that verifies        quality before anything reaches you.                                                              Unlike single-AI tools that forget your          project the moment you close the tab, TinyPM     learns your patterns, anticipates what you       need before you ask, and delivers work that's    already been reviewed.
